about.contact.title: Contact
proj.desc.expo: A lightweight data store library for Expo apps led by me, aiming to provide a fast, lightweight local storage solution with cleaner formatting than scattered JSON files.
proj.desc.workbench: A local-first AI Agent workbench with risk-based permission approval, encrypted SQLite persistent state, multi-model provider configuration (OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini), Web UI and CLI.
proj.desc.screenshot: A high-quality web screenshot tool supporting 12 device presets, batch processing, high-DPI rendering, dark mode and metadata generation, designed for multimodal LLM visual analysis.
proj.desc.reflexlm: An experimental implementation of a bounded native synapse interface (NSI) runtime, focused on falsifiable mechanism verification, including structured receptors, salience and inhibition models, and controlled command-selection benchmarks.
proj.desc.reference: Contributing to a collection of developer cheatsheets covering common technologies, tools and workflows, helping developers quickly look up key information. The project has earned 15.1k Stars.
